text:
Michelle: quick heads-up — ran the kb link health sweep and found ~7 orphan anchors in runtime guide.
Ron: thanks! any pattern? where are they mostly?
Michelle: mostly under /runtime and /about-deploys, small anchor name changes after the last MD refactor.
Sam: can you paste a sample? I can open a tiny PR.
Michelle: here's the ripgrep I used:
```
rg "href=\".*#" content/ | sed -n '1,30p'
```
Michelle: PR I opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/3247
Maddy: nice, taking a look now.
link-scanner-bot: [scan result] 7 orphan anchors detected in /content/runtime; ticket #DOC-482 created.
Ron: who owns runtime guide atm? cc @maddy
Maddy: I own the runtime guide chapter but happy to triage. will review PR today.
Sam: if PR is tiny we can merge after one review — @maddy or @ron can you do the review?
Ron: I can do it after standup, ping me at 10:15
Michelle: also added a small note in the PR about keeping anchor ids stable — maybe add to contributor guide.
Sam: +1. could someone add a line to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md under "links and anchors"?
Maddy: I'll add that as a follow-up PR (will include the ripgrep command and a tiny CI check suggestion).
Michelle: suggestion for CI check: run a link scan in CI and fail on orphan anchors. pseudo:
```
npm run link-scan || exit 1
```
Sam: putting a reviewer on the follow-up PR: @ron
Ron: SG, will review that too.
Michelle: also FYI found 1 image 403 in onboarding guide — filed inline comment in PR.
Maddy: thanks. anyone free for a quick async pairing to make the CI check? 20m?
Sam: I can do 20:30 PST
Michelle: works for me.
link-scanner-bot: note: scheduled weekly sweep set for Mon 08:00 UTC.
Ron: perfect. thumbs up if you can join the pairing: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Michelle: :thumbsup:
Maddy: :thumbsup:
Michelle: cool, will merge the tiny fix once @maddy approves and then we can plan the follow-up PR.
Sam: cheers — will add a checklist item to the sprint board under Docs: "anchor stability + CI scan".
Maddy: adding now.
Michelle: thanks all! lunch on me if we get the CI check in this week :salute:
Ron: hold me to that :laughing:
